The leftmost point on the semicircle is the point with the smallest x-coordinate. From the perception triples, T2 and T12 indicate points on the semicircle with x-coordinates -7 and 7 respectively. Since -7 is less than 7, the leftmost point is -7.
The leftmost point on the semicircle is given by T2 as (-7, 0). Therefore, the y-coordinate of the leftmost point is 0.

The rightmost point on the semicircle is the point with the largest x-coordinate. From the perception triples, T2 and T12 indicate points on the semicircle with x-coordinates -7 and 7 respectively. Since 7 is greater than -7, the rightmost point is 7.
The rightmost point on the semicircle is given by T12 as (7, 0). Therefore, the y-coordinate of the rightmost point is 0.
